entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF-95713. And let me be clear, I'm not looking into it, I'm getting a refund. Today. These shoes have given me the worst blisters of my life.

I understand your frustration, and I do apologize for the discomfort they've caused. I've pulled up your order. Just to be sure I have all the details, what specifically is the issue? Is it a problem with the fit causing the blisters, or do you believe there's a technical fault with the shoe?

Are you kidding me? The issue is your product is garbage! I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, I've tried different socks... nothing works. It's a bad design. I want my money back. This is ridiculous. Get me your manager right now.
I don't think a manager will be necessary, I'm confident I can resolve this for you right here. Let me just quickly review the return eligibility for your cycling shoes. One moment.
You'd better. I swear if I don't get a full refund, I'm going to plaster this all over your social media and every cycling forum on the internet.

I appreciate your patience. Okay, I've checked the policy. I can see that your order was delivered within the last 90 days, so you are well within the window for a return. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. So you can do it? Just like that? No more games?

Yes, absolutely. No games. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, package the shoes, and drop them with the carrier. Once we receive them back at our warehouse, the refund will be credited to your original payment method.
Huh. Okay. Well, fine. That's what I expected in the first place. Make sure that label comes through immediately.
It has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
